title: Dinobrik's Rum Recipes
description: Adds an in-game recipe book for viewing recipes from Dinobrik's Rum Datapack.
body:
## This pack requires Dinobrik's Rum Datapack to be installed to function.

I thought it was a bit annoying how none the drink recipes for Dinobrik's Rum Datapack were available in-game (excluding one). So I made a datapack to help solve the issue.

The Book of Drinks can be crafted from a Book & Quill and a Glass Bottle, and provides almost every drink recipe. A few exceptions:

- **Cursed Rum** is missing as even I don't know the recipe and could not find it for the life of me. That probably means the player is not meant to know it easily
- **Roscuro's Squeak** is a recipe that requires solving a riddle in the Dinobrik discord server to make. Thus, I figured I should keep it that way
- **Dwarven Whisky** is normally only found as a recipe in Abandoned Mineshafts. I personally wouldn't want to search a mineshaft to find a single recipe, so I added it in the book--but it's incomplete. Players will either need to figure out *how much* of the ingredients they need to add to make the drink, or just go find the recipe as intended to find the correct amounts.
- **Aging Recipes** are not included in the book. I didn't have time to go through and make them all in the book (maybe at some point but very unlikely). If you want to know EVERY aging recipe, go join the Dinobrik discord server
  - **Milkshakes** are missing for the same reason. They are explained in the youtube video that Dinobrik provides for the original pack, otherwise they're also in the discord server

If you encounter any bugs or issues UNRELATED to the Book of Drinks, please inform Dinobrik and NOT me.
